blocks.content:
Before 1992, local bodies were not constitutional entities.

Important Amendments:
• 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992 – Panchayati Raj Institutions
• 74th Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992 – Urban Local Bodies

Both came into force in 1993.
Before 1992, local bodies were not constitutional entities.

items: Remember the key distinction: 73rd Amendment pertains to Panchayati Raj Institutions, whereas 74th Amendment pertains to Urban Local Bodies.
Both amendments were enacted in 1992 but came into force in 1993.
Questions often ask about the constitutional status of local bodies prior to 1992 (they were non-constitutional entities).

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Prior to 1992, local bodies lacked constitutional recognition in India.
The 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992 relates to Panchayati Raj Institutions.
The 74th Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992 relates to Urban Local Bodies.
Both the 73rd and 74th Constitutional Amendment Acts came into force in 1993.
